tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: ¿Cómo reaccionó Lucía al oír el resultado?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “¿Cómo reaccionó Javier al ver la factura?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue tile offers two verbs of change, like ponerse / quedarse: choose the one that fits, then put it in the right form and add se. Quick change of mood: ponerse. State after an event: quedarse. Character: volverse. Profession: hacerse. A tile in brackets, like (él), says who; it is not written.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: «Ponerse» es un cambio rápido: se puso rojo.
